paras: In [[spring|spring]], soft [[rain|rain]] falls on our small [[garden|garden]]. The ground smells fresh when the sun returns.
A yellow [[flower|flower]] opens beside the old [[tree|tree]]. Drops of water shine on every leaf.
I sit by the window and [[paint|paint]] the scene. I use green for the leaves and leave a bright space for the flower.
zh: 春天，细雨落在我们的小花园里。太阳重新出现时，泥土散发出清新的气味。
老树旁开出一朵黄色的花。每片叶子上的水滴都闪闪发亮。
我坐在窗边画下这幅景象。我用绿色画叶子，并为那朵花留出一块明亮的地方。

q.s: The story takes place in spring.
q.why: The first phrase sets the season.
